# `modules/EditorPointCloud.js`

> **Source:** `editor/js/modules/EditorPointCloud.js`

============================================================================ EditorPointCloud.js — Point cloud entity management  Handles spawning point cloud entities from asset files (PLY/PCD/XYZ), managing the PointCloud component, and bridging to the EntityMeshRenderer point-sprite render pass. ============================================================================

## Functions

### `async spawnPointCloudAsset(editor, asset)`

Load a point cloud asset, parse it, and create an entity in the scene.

**Parameters:**

- `editor` *(Object)* — EditorApp instance
- `asset` *(Object)* — Asset entry from AssetRegistry

### `spawnPointCloudEntity(editor, pcData, opts = {})`

Create a point cloud entity from raw point data.

**Parameters:**

- `editor` *(Object)* — EditorApp instance
- `opts` *(Object)* — _No description in source JSDoc._
- `opts.name` *(string)* — Entity name
- `opts.assetId` *(string)* — Source asset UUID (optional)
- `opts.pointSize` *(number)* — Point radius in world units
- `opts.color` *(number[])* — Fallback RGBA color [r,g,b,a] 0-1

**Returns:** entityId

### `registerPointCloudForRendering(editor, entityId, points, colors, pointSize)`

Register a point cloud entity's data with the EntityMeshRenderer's point-sprite render pass.

### `restorePointCloudGpuResources(editor)`

### `unregisterPointCloud(editor, entityId)`

Unregister a point cloud entity from the renderer.

### `getPointCloudData(editor, entityId)`

Get point cloud data for an entity (reads PointCloud component).

**Returns:** | null}

## Notes & Examples

### Editor Extension System

The editor supports extensions via the same Plauna component system as apps. Extensions can add panels, tools, menu items, and hooks into the engine. They run with elevated 'editor' capability granting access to the scene graph, asset database, and build pipeline.

**Example: Editor extension adding a custom panel**
```js
import { Extension } from 'editor/core/Extension.js';
import { Panel } from 'editor/ui/Panel.js';

class TerrainEditor extends Extension {
  id = 'terrain-editor';
  capabilities = ['editor', 'scene'];
  
  activate(context) {
    // Add menu item
    context.menus.add('Tools/Terrain', () => this.open());
    
    // Register tool
    context.tools.register('terrain', {
      icon: 'mountain',
      onSelect: (entity) => this.edit(entity)
    });
  }
  
  open() {
    this.panel = new Panel({
      title: 'Terrain Editor',
      content: this.buildUI()
    });
    context.workspace.addPanel(this.panel);
  }
  
  edit(entity) {
    const terrain = entity.get(TerrainComponent);
    this.panel.bind(terrain);
  }
}

editor.extensions.register(TerrainEditor);
```
